page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m4.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.s6 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 8 virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This instance utilizes a KVM hypervisor and features a shared CPU allocation model, meaning physical CPU resources are shared among multiple instances.

This server configuration does not include any local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps. Additionally, the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Due to its shared CPU allocation model and lack of local storage or specialized accelerators, the ecs.s6-c1m4.2xlarge offers a cost-efficient profile for workloads that do not require dedicated physical cores or high-performance local disk I/O. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it appropriate for general-purpose workloads, such as web serving, development environments, and lightweight application hosting, where resource demands are moderate and bursty rather than sustained at maximum capacity.
